Map_Custom_Styling.details: Map View has 'Map Style' button for custom map styling options

Map_Category_Filter.details: Map View has category filter section (data-testid='category-filter-section') with 19 color-coded checkboxes for filtering results by category

Admin_User_Management.details: Admin endpoints working: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/ban (ban user), POST /api/admin/users/{id}/mute (mute user), DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} (delete user), GET /api/admin/moderation/actions (view action log)
